description: Machine-readable source of truth mapping every geometry_diagnostics/1 metric to the FigOps figure-quality rubric. The additive raw_metric_semantics section documents geometry_diagnostics/2 candidate facts; raw facts do not carry policy verdicts.

raw_metric_semantics.compatibility: This section is documentation-only and additive. The geometry_diagnostics/1 metrics mapping and public legacy metric names remain unchanged; the frozen geometry_diagnostics/2 top-level and measurement discriminator fields remain unchanged. New pair facts stay nested under an existing measurement value object.

artist_pair_iou.semantics: Legacy `iou` overlap fraction (intersection area divided by the smaller candidate-box area) over bounded axis-aligned display-space artist boxes. The field name is retained for compatibility; it is an approximation, not mathematical union IoU or exact painted-ink/centerline collision. Line candidates use padded axis-aligned boxes.
artist_pair_iou.scope: Per data axis over the bounded candidates assembled by the neutral raw measurement path, including visible legends, title/text artists, line segments, patches, and marker-footprint boxes where available.
artist_pair_iou.line_pair_metadata: When exactly one pair member is a line segment, the pair may additionally carry `centerline_intersection_px` and `centerline_intersects`, measured against the other candidate box with positive-length Liang-Barsky clipping. These fields are absent for non-line and line-line pairs; a zero value identifies a bbox-only candidate contact without changing the legacy `iou`.
artist_pair_iou.policy_verdict: None. Pair counts and IoU values are raw facts; they do not imply pass, fail, severity, or publication readiness. A selected policy projection supplies any verdict.

line_text_crossings.semantics: Exact display-space centerline-versus-text-bounding-box intersection for a line segment with more than the geometry epsilon of positive length inside the text box. It does not use the padded line AABB used by artist_pair_iou.
line_text_crossings.scope: Per data axis, visible paintable Axes.get_lines() (using each line's own transform, including blended axhline/axvline transforms) against visible non-empty ax.title and ax.texts only. Tick labels, legends, patches, markers, and other axes are out of scope; line, segment, and text candidates are bounded and truncation is reported.
line_text_crossings.policy_verdict: None. Crossing counts and reported crossing facts are raw measurements only; they do not imply pass, fail, severity, or publication readiness. A selected policy projection supplies any verdict.

tick_label_overlaps.rationale: Tick label collisions can prevent values or categories from being read.

tick_label_crowding.rationale: Dense tick labels are an advisory label-density issue unless readability is blocked.

artists_outside_axes.rationale: Data or required artists outside the intended axes can hide the plotted result.

artists_outside_figure.rationale: Required artists outside the figure boundary violate journal-safe geometry.

legend_data_collision.non_blocking_reason: Current implementation reports bbox-union overlap as context only; it is not an ink-accurate blocking gate.

axis_label_title_overlap.rationale: Axis labels overlapping titles can block figure readability.

figure_title_panel_title_overlap.rationale: Figure and panel title collisions can block title interpretation.

colorbar_overlap.rationale: Colorbar overlap can obscure labels, marks, or scale interpretation.

blank_area_ratio.rationale: Excessive blank area can indicate hidden data or a view that no longer shows the validated result.

point_annotation_overlaps.rationale: Point annotation overlaps can prevent labels or associated marks from being read.

artist_overlaps.rationale: General artist collisions can block interpretation of labels, marks, or annotations.

legend_internal_overlaps.rationale: Legend item collisions can make series identity unreadable.

marker_marker_overlaps.rationale: Severe marker pile-up can hide data visibility and distribution.

text_axis_edge_proximity.rationale: Text near the axis edge is an advisory label placement issue unless it blocks readability.

legend_marker_consistency.rationale: Legend marker/style mismatches affect visual hierarchy and series identification polish.

label_offset_consistency.rationale: Inconsistent point-label offsets affect panel balance and placement consistency.

point_label_skips.rationale: Skipped point labels are an advisory density/readability finding unless required labels disappear.

annotation_overlay_contrast.rationale: Annotation contrast is an advisory accessibility finding unless required text becomes unreadable.

font_size_token_drift.rationale: Font sizes below selected style or journal floors violate journal-safe geometry.

journal_compliance.rationale: Selected journal/style token violations are hard-gate journal-safe geometry findings.
